layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: a single item sprite shown whole and centred on a transparent background, a slight three-quarter angle looking a little down, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Faction: sturdy cheerful steampunk craft of the deep mountain forges. Its fixed colours: soot-black riveted iron with a thin light warm grey highlight along every lit edge; bright polished copper pipes, boilers and bands, colour #c27c3a; dark brown leather straps and aprons; small puffs of pure white steam from smokestacks; small details of rivets and gears.
layers.negative: brass, gold, yellow, bright orange, fire, flames, red, crimson, green, lime, purple, violet, magenta, pink, blue, cyan, glowing lights, white beard, grey beard, blond beard, rust, wooden planks, robe, hood, cloak, magic, skull, medieval knight, sword, bow, scary, horror, realistic

layers.text: Class: one bold chunky item sprite with a single clear subject and a big simple silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat colours with one shadow tone, very few details; it must read at a glance at 48 pixels. The item floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it.

layers.text: Subject: Sea Tunnels: one big cone-shaped copper drill bit with spiral grooves and a soot-black iron collar, pointing sideways from left to right, boring through a thick band of dark brown earth; above the earth band one curling pale blue-white water wave crest with a small white foam curl; the drill is clearly under the wave; nothing else in the image.
